comment: The reporting calendar is a conformed dimension. Facts built from it (e.g. fct_subscription_months) and rollups of those facts (e.g. fct_mrr_bridge) both join it directly for month labels and completeness flags; this is the intended star-schema pattern, not a redundant dependency.

Month-end AR needs each payment's timestamp to know what was paid before every cutoff, finer than the per-invoice int_invoice_payment_summary it also reads for paid_at, written_off_at and due_at. Rebuilding those without the summary would duplicate its rules and still rejoin payments via int_invoice_delinquency_periods. Scoped to this child, so other rejoins of payments are still flagged.
